description: PRIMARY TOOL when the user has authorized source media or a concrete social-video goal. Produces a non-executing Creative Director plan, checks the current 35 MiB bounded customer pipeline, selects creative style and caption treatment, and plans Facebook/LinkedIn/Instagram copy. It recommends ForensiScope upstream for oversized, long, deduplication-heavy, or full-timeline media. Use get_clip_capabilities only for a general capability question. It does not upload media, create an order, charge a user, transfer private media, or publish.

caption_mode.description: Caption treatment to plan for the finished clip.

complex_media.description: Set true for media that needs deeper scene, evidence, or structure analysis before clipping.

creative_style.description: Preferred creative treatment for the planned edit.

goal.description: Plain-language outcome the user wants from the social-video job.

needs_deduplication.description: Set true when repeated or near-duplicate segments need to be detected before clip planning.

needs_full_timeline.description: Set true when the job requires understanding the full source timeline rather than only bounded clip selection.

source_duration_seconds.description: Source media duration in seconds when known.

source_file_size_bytes.description: Source media file size in bytes when known. Used to detect the current bounded-render limit and recommend ForensiScope when needed.

target_platforms.description: Desired output platforms, such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or LinkedIn. Planning does not publish.

name: plan_clip_job
title: Start here: plan an Evercraft Clip social-video job
